title: Governance report: spend, confirmations, signatures and gate outcomes across flows

AC1.note: src/governance/report.test.ts: AC1: summarizeReviewSpend sums only what rounds reported, never coercing absence to 0; AC1: a flow where no round ever recorded cost reports spend as not-recorded, never 0; AC1: the report aggregates review-round cost from real manifest.json files under a flow, across rounds. bun test src/governance/ -> 47 pass, 0 fail.

AC2.note: src/governance/report.test.ts: AC2: an absent trigger ledger reports a demonstrated $0, not an unknown; AC2: trigger spend sums recorded runs and counts unrecorded ones separately, never folding them into $0; AC2: a trigger run record carries no flow reference, so project-wide spend is never folded into any flow's total. bun test src/governance/ -> 47 pass, 0 fail.

AC3.note: src/governance/report.test.ts: AC3: a flow with no signatures field at all reports confirmations as not recorded (predates signing); AC3: confirmations join acConfirmed with the matching ac-confirm signature, identity basis included, unmatched confirmations show identity undefined, never a fabricated verified confirmer. bun test src/governance/ -> 47 pass, 0 fail.

AC4.note: src/governance/report.test.ts: AC4: a flow with no completionAttempts reports gate outcomes as not recorded; AC4: every recorded completion attempt (pass or fail) is surfaced, with every gate it evaluated. src/flow/completion-attempts.test.ts: AC4: a failing attempt then a passing one both land on completionAttempts, in order, each with its own gate outcomes; AC4: a completion attempt is recorded even on a pre-change fixture that never had completionAttempts or gates; AC4 review fix: a tamper caught between gate evaluation and persistence is still recorded on disk, as a failed attempt naming the tamper. bun test src/governance/ src/flow/completion-attempts.test.ts -> 47 pass, 0 fail (part of same run).

AC5.note: src/governance/report.test.ts: AC5: building and writing the report never modifies anything under .metaproject/flows or .metaproject/data/trigger. bun test src/governance/ -> 47 pass, 0 fail.

AC6.note: src/governance/report.test.ts: AC6: writing the report produces latest.md and a schema-versioned latest.json, both readable back; AC6: no report yet reads as absent, never a crash; AC6: a malformed stored report reads as malformed, not a crash and not an empty valid report. bun test src/governance/ -> 47 pass, 0 fail.

AC7.note: src/governance/report.test.ts: AC7: --flow narrows to the one flow; AC7: --owner narrows to flows with that exact owner, excluding flows with no owner; AC7: --since/--until narrow by each flow's own updatedAt. bun test src/governance/ -> 47 pass, 0 fail.

AC8.note: src/governance/report.test.ts: AC8: --all-projects covers the current project plus every registered project; a missing one is listed skipped, never failing the whole report. bun test src/governance/ -> 47 pass, 0 fail.

AC9.note: src/governance/report.test.ts: AC9: policy allow/ask/deny decisions are reported as not recorded, with a reason, never omitted. bun test src/governance/ -> 47 pass, 0 fail.

AC10.note: README.md line 444 lists governance under project capabilities (keryx governance report); docs/docs/cli-reference.md lines 1490-1530+ document keryx governance report/show, every flag (--flow/--owner/--since/--until/--all-projects/--json), where it writes (.metaproject/data/governance/artifacts/latest.md and latest.json), what it reads, gate-outcome persistence, and the not-recorded-never-zero rule matching review budget and trigger status conventions.

AC11.note: gh pr checks 652 --repo MrCipherSmith/keryx: 18/18 required checks pass (client matrix cancel-resume/runtime/streaming/terminal, dependency-audit, linux sandbox bubblewrap live smoke, macOS real-host legs, metrics-contract, mkdocs build --strict, opentui native x4, standard-baseline, standard-pr, typecheck-and-tests, vscode-extension, wiki validate+freshness), 1 skipped (deploy to GitHub Pages, non-required) at PR head 97d6c189, merged as 1ce98384. bun run src/cli.ts health run: PASS, project score 94 (trend: stable), findings 324, no gate conditions triggered.
